scope: Independent read-only reconstruction from existing artifact bytes, saved raw prediction rows and recorded receipts. No model inference, training or unit tests were performed in this initial review.
record_kind: Summary of completed checks; transient inspection scripts and tool outputs were used. This file is not a fabricated per-check execution log.

Manifest canonical digest and tensor file digest match checkpoint bindings and owner registry
Training input JSON digest matches model lineage dataset digest
All model and checkpoint source commit bindings match the frozen source commit
Model parent IDs, generations and tensor digests match immutable registry records
Per-fit parameter counts, input/target/source counts and optimizer receipts agree
Every checkpoint has total rank 16, 3072 parameters and 24576 parameter bytes
Checkpoint directory inventory and receipt bodies equal the cost ledger inventory
Actual per-arm file bytes plus source stream and withdrawal bytes equal retained-byte ledger
Summed actual write receipts equal write_seconds ledger

Clean selected models have no inherited parent and exclude revoked source IDs

Four-update macro accuracy and query-weighted stream accuracy reproduce the saved summary

resource_equation_review.formula: upfront = byte_price * retained_bytes + training_second_price * (write_seconds + other_maintenance_seconds_including_migrations + shared_setup_seconds_charged_once) + read_second_price * selection_read_seconds; expected = upfront + read_second_price * read_seconds_per_query * 40000; net = policy_macro - comparator_macro - policy_expected/40000 + comparator_expected/40000

recorded_inventory.optimizer_steps_note: Summed per-fit optimizer_steps=300; inherited cumulative manifest.total_steps were not summed.

efficacy_findings.accepted_operations: Only seeds 227 and 233 adopted domain split ranks [12,4] at the 1280-source update; all other updates retained structure. No merge was adopted.

withdrawal_findings.initial_review_evidence_gap: Deleted-key raw predictions and serving responses were only retained as summary counts, so they could not be independently recounted from saved per-query rows during this read-only review.
withdrawal_findings.method: Full fresh retraining, not selective parameter erasure. Tombstone refusal is not proof of unlearning or physical source deletion.

limitations: Recorded optimizer receipts and migration parity observations were inspected; the initial review did not repeat training or model execution.
The four-update macro includes an initial 100-percent accuracy snapshot; final clean policy accuracy was only about 32.49 to 37.62 percent.
Given-domain split [12,4] left clean domain-B accuracy at about 14.42 percent for seed 227 and 11.96 percent for seed 233.
Deployment parameter budget is matched and full candidate costs are charged, but extra optimization opportunities are not causally isolated by a same-optimizer-step control.
Given domain routing and two successful split seeds do not establish a universal self-organizing memory network.
